为冷库库存单独写去重查询：表cold_stock，按sku分组，保留updated_at最新的记录。给一段完整SQL。

```sql
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        cs.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY sku
            ORDER BY updated_at DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM cold_stock cs
) t
WHERE rn = 1;
```
